squareSelection: Use square tops across each same-layer cardinal-connected ground cohort touching ground one layer above within a 3x3 neighborhood. Hover previews query the cohort without changing emitted neighbors.
regularReliefConstruction: Add sparse, shallow inward facets inside broad exposed BoulderMassNN and ShoulderRockNN triangles. Preserve every accepted vertex and edge, body bounds, core, base, backing, lip seal and cap. Depth is 0.0036 to 0.006 tile units, additionally limited to 0.06 times the distance to the nearest triangle edge. Avoid cutting through overlapping neighbouring rocks. Bottom bodies remain byte-identical to revision 5. Normal export preserves native edits; explicit -- --remodel-regular-relief reconstructs this detail from frozen regular revision-2 meshes.
regularRockBoundsGroups: Accepted BoulderMassNN; new ShoulderRockNN use the separate shoulder bounds.
regularWallConstruction: Preserve accepted lower boulders, exact recessed joining panels and the two full unit base triangles at Z=0. Replace the outer vertical collar at Z>=0.78 with unequal closed rock shoulders rising from Z>=0.40 to just beneath the cap lip. Retain the exact horizontal lip seal. All new shoulders stay inside the unit footprint; interior bodies retain only their two base triangles.
bottomWallConstruction: Preserve the accepted backing core, lower boulders and floating fragments, except the outer vertical collar at Z>=0.78. Replace that collar with closed rock shoulders rooted into the existing boulders and rising from Z>=0.40 to just below the cap lip. The exact horizontal lip seal, both retained UV charts, authored caps and shared PBR maps stay intact.
bottomFloorConstruction: An irregular triangulated floor closes the recessed core; staggered embedded boulder masses form the visible rocky underside.
bottomOverhangPolicy: Exposed cardinal sides may overhang by at most 0.04 tile units. New shoulder overhang is at most 0.04 below Z=0.78, then tapers to zero at its roof just beneath the cap lip. Hidden connection planes retain the unit footprint and their lower border at Z=-0.34. Authored cap borders remain unchanged.
bottomBorderCompression: The accepted V4 BoulderMassNN and FloatingRockNN shapes already received affine XY compression from a 0.12 to 0.04 exposed envelope. The current shoulder transition preserves those accepted masses exactly and replaces only the outer upper collar with separate ShoulderRockNN meshes.
bottomExportPolicy: Normal exports preserve artist edits. The legacy -- --remodel-bottom-variants option rebuilds the V4 lower design from immutable original construction meshes; tools/sculpt_ground_shoulders.py -- --remodel-shoulders rebuilds the current transition from the frozen accepted chunky bodies and updates linked previews. Authored caps and shared PBR maps stay unchanged.
bottomSelection: Use the bottom body when no full-cell ground, wall, cliff wall, decorative block or live ice block exists directly below in the full level/editor document or current movable state. Hidden layers still provide support; water, air, thin plates and moving platforms do not. Logical cell bounds and authored caps are unchanged.
